description: Flinders Truffles runs guided truffle hunts on their Flinders farm during winter (June–August). Participants walk through oak fields with truffle dogs to forage for Périgord black truffles. Includes truffle soup and truffle cheese toastie by the fire. Farmgate days allow purchase of fresh truffles and truffle products without booking. Industry-only mid-week hunts available for restaurant teams.
priceRange: Hunt pricing TBC (contact via website); farmgate products from approx AUD 20+
recurrenceNote: Multiple sessions through June–August; check Facebook/Instagram for dates
weatherDependency: Outdoor — wear warm clothes and closed shoes; hunts run in rain as well
nearbyAttractions: Mornington Peninsula Chocolaterie (Flinders); Polperro Winery (truffle dinner partner); Crittenden winter truffle escape
suggestedItineraryPairing: Book a truffle hunt in the morning; truffle dinner at Polperro in the evening; great winter weekend pairing
internalNotes: Specific 2026 hunt dates not yet published on main events page; follow @flinderstruffles on Facebook/Instagram for booking announcements.
